evidenceCoverage.baselineDescription: No pre-adoption comparison is included; observations begin at adoption.
evidenceCoverage.reason: No comparable pre-adoption outcome evaluation is established for this contract.

caveat: The evidence measures post-adoption attainment only; without a comparable pre-adoption baseline it cannot establish improvement or causation.

intent.goal: For each activated initial workflow execution, demonstrate that each of the twelve source-required development tools is usable inside its agent container, by an actual native version/function invocation and valid native output.
intent.acceptance: A reviewed container-bound engine transport must independently correlate the source-required native version/function invocation with its successful completion and recognizable tool output. Equivalent native Java version flags and static absolute system paths are allowed. Agent prose, setup declarations, host-only version checks and mutable uploaded session files alone never establish execution.

evidence.historicalCapability: The same tool-usability phenomenon predates adoption. No independent pre-adoption container invocation corpus has been retained in this acquisition; attainment-only, not created-at-adoption.
evidence.opportunity: All retained runs created from adoption through the exclusive frozen cutoff, including every initial attempt. Reruns do not create duplicate opportunities. Skipped activation or skipped execution creates no tool opportunity; missing initial-attempt jobs leave eligibility unknown.
filters: Tool outcome predicates are stable since adoption; runtime pins, engine, container and transport changes are retained as separate profiles. No cross-profile trend is inferred.

Count independently established native tool proofs, preserving partial improvement. A complete total requires every eligible tool assessment. Known failures can establish zero; absent receipts cannot.
Version/function checks measure the source-required smoke facet, not compiler correctness, package restoration, arbitrary builds or every future invocation.
Source runtime pins are retained as context, not invented version-conformance requirements: the source's acceptance asks availability and valid output.
Imported Playwright title validation and token-telemetry checks are separate safeguards; they do not prove any of the twelve tools.
A successful run, comment or agent-printed version string is not a native execution receipt.
Deleted executions and expired logs/artifacts cannot be reconstructed from a present-day container replay.
Costs, exclusive causation, a keep threshold and full smoke acceptance are not measured.
evidence.collection: Offline replay of complete retained initial-attempt inventory and digest-checked source-bound native host tool-execution receipts. Unknown history remains null.

model.architecture: Independent protected engine transport pairs actual container-side shell commands with native output; twelve tool opportunities per activated initial execution.
model.recommendation: Inspect missing receipts separately from observed native proof delivery. No keep or retire threshold is established.

metrics.name: Observed native container tool proofs
metrics.formula: Count distinct (initial run, required tool) opportunities with an independent successful native invocation and valid output; preserve known proofs through gaps.

metrics.name: Complete native container tool proofs
metrics.formula: The same native count only when all eligible tool assessments and eligibility are known.
